title: RankJudge：多轮对话LLM裁判合成基准生成器
summary: RankJudge是一个用于评估LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）在多轮对话中表现的新型基准生成器。它通过注入单一缺陷生成成对对话，实现无歧义的优劣标注和精确的错误定位。覆盖机器学习、生物医学和金融领域，评估了21个前沿LLM裁判，并利用Bradley-Terry模型进行排名。该方法还支持动态选择评估子集以减少标签噪声。
summary_en: RankJudge is a benchmark generator for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge on multi-turn conversations. It creates paired conversations with a single injected flaw, enabling unambiguous labeling and precise error localization. Evaluates 21 frontier LLM judges across ML, biomedicine, and finance, ranking them via Bradley-Terry model. Supports dynamic evaluation slice curation to reduce label noise.
